caveats: Stated MW is source-reported by DataCentersNearMe from public records and directories; the source does not always say whether the figure is IT load, utility demand, or campus build-out.
Most campuses have no stated MW (only those with a number are summed). State shading is total stated MW, not site count.
666 campuses are withheld from the DataCentersNearMe download because their only source cannot be redistributed; they are not on this map.
131 campuses are known only to the county and have no pin.
Proposed and permitted MW may never be built. Directory figures can overlap or be overstated. Estimates are not bids, bills, or filed costs.
Default totals exclude withdrawn and rejected campuses; they can be turned on in the filters.
Power cost is an estimate: stated MW × 8,760 h × 50% load × that state's EIA industrial average for August 2026. Large customers often have their own contracts.
For information only. Not for engineering, legal, or investment decisions.
